## How To Add A Snippet Of Code To Every Page Of A Site in The HEAD Section


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682658

There are many 3rd party applications that require adding a snippet of code to every page on the website. To do this, we simply add the code to the Website's HEAD. Place the code that the 3rd party application requires to be present on every page on the site. Go to Settings >> Design Settings:
